requirements.text: Keep source authority tiers distinct: explicit user brief and named Duroflex scope govern the assignment; the May 2025 Strategic Blueprint supplies strategic intent (Motivating Reset) rather than product efficacy proof; the 151-slide Visual World Guide remains an unapproved draft throughout (even on slides marked mandatory, approved, or locked); interior archive images are advisory inspiration only; and exact official SKU pages govern product identity and available facts.

Preserve the exact selected official SKU's colour, fabric texture, seams, edge construction, controls, and authentic physical product labels/branding without recolouring, inventing mechanisms, or removing genuine product markings.

Do not use fake white patches, contrast fades, added haze, blur masks, or artificial gradients inside photographs to create copy space; rely on genuine architectural wall/floor space or clearly separate graphic panels.

Treat strategic positioning statements (such as 200K strands, 4X airflow, cortisol reduction, or stress/pain relief) and website marketing copy (such as 1 lakh+ fibres, 3X breathability, or healing/circulation language) as attributed statements rather than portable proof; require current, product-specific approved substantiation before making medical, physiological, quantified, or guarantee claims.

Express the strategic essence of 'Motivating Reset' and 'Designed to De-Stress' as warm, attentive, supportive, and insightful everyday restoration that helps people get back in the game—never promising a dramatic makeover, fear-mongering about stress/anxiety, making people feel bad about their lifestyle, or borrowing clinical or luxury-spa tropes.

preferences.text: Prefer the current public identity observed on the official website and November 2025 announcement—a solid red symbol with uppercase DUROFLEX and the 'Designed to De-Stress' philosophy—over the draft guide's unapproved lowercase serif wordmark and older 'Better Sleep / A Brighter You' tagline, pending vector master confirmation.

Use Duroflex red primarily as a brand signal and graphic punctuation (logo, product tag, CTA, thin accent line, or restrained graphic anchor) rather than flooding the room; avoid red curtains, red bedding, red props, and red outfits until the draft guide's internal contradictions are resolved.

Build calm through contemporary Indian domestic architecture and navigable circulation (clear entrance-to-window routes, low horizontal furniture, recessed storage, usable bedside/seating access, and framed exterior greenery) rather than hotel suites, resort arches, or beige minimalism.

Support the unchanged SKU colour with layered tonal separation and tactile variety—using draft palette proposals like bone, sand, taupe, stone, sage, olive, clay, wine, midnight blue, and soft sky alongside matte wood, stone, limewash/textured plaster, linen, and cotton—without forcing a single neutral palette across all categories.

Establish one credible primary light source (such as side glazing casting gentle shadows) supported by believable practical lamps, keeping SKU colours truthful; pair frontal silhouettes, three-quarter room views, and close contact/detail views rather than relying on wide-angle distortion.

Direct believable physical support and everyday participation—stretching, reading, reclining, conversing, or preparing to go out—dressed in relaxed, matte homewear (linen, washed cotton, fine jersey in muted tones), avoiding camera stares, thumbs-up, presenter poses, and forced ad smiles.

Flex environmental mood by category while keeping brand identity constant: airy daylight bedrooms for mattresses/beds (restrained blue-white freshness for Airboost; warm domestic trust without medical theatre for Duropedic); social warm lounges with verified extension clearance for sofas/motion; sheltered reading corners for recliners; intimate bedside contact for pillows; and warm domestic corners (not dark floating voids or clinics) for Neuma massagers.

Favour clean sans-serif information hierarchy, one clear focal message per layout, thin proof icons, and soft-edged/rounded graphic containment kept distinct from the room photograph, avoiding discount-poster clutter or starbursts.

visualRules.value: Maintain exact official SKU appearance, colour, fabric grain, seams, controls, and authentic physical product labels; never recolour products to match room palettes or remove genuine branding.
Prohibit fake white patches, contrast fades, artificial haze, blur masks, and gradient overlays inside photographic scenes; use real architectural planes for copy space or separate graphic panels.

Preserve natural skin truth, fabric texture, realistic daylight shadows, and accurate physical contact/compression between body and product; never use plastic skin retouching or unverified technical cutaways.

Treat all 151 Visual World Guide slides, scorecards, and locked-character pages as draft proposals and all Archive.zip rooms as advisory references, never as mandatory rules overriding official SKU facts.

preserve: Duroflex's established scope across mattresses, sofas, recliners, beds, pillows, accessories, and smart sleep solutions, rooted in its 1963 Kerala heritage.
The public 'Designed to De-Stress' philosophy and the strategic 'Motivating Reset' essence (attentive, insightful, supportive, warm companion helping people get back in the game every day).
Strict source hierarchy: exact official SKU pages for product truth, May 2025 blueprint for strategy, and the 151-slide Visual World Guide as a draft blueprint.
Truthful product representation: unchanged SKU colour, fabric weave, seams, mechanical geometry, and authentic physical labels.
Clean photographic integrity: real architectural copy space and natural lighting without fake white patches, blur masks, haze, or in-photo contrast fades.
explore: Six adaptable contemporary Indian spatial families: (1) compact connected everyday home, (2) garden-threshold reset, (3) filtered-light contemporary room, (4) warm architectural social lounge, (5) sheltered reading/recovery corner, and (6) colour-led softly articulated bedroom.
Active participation and post-rest readiness narratives: reading, conversation, hobbies, stretching, and preparing to step out—moving beyond a campaign of only closed eyes.
Tonal and material depth around the SKU: pairing bone, sand, stone, and taupe with sage, olive, clay, wine, midnight blue, or soft sky in matte wood, plaster, stone, and breathable linen/cotton.

Category-specific atmosphere within one brand world: crisp opening-led daylight for Airboost and Duropedic bedrooms, warm evening practical light for motion sofas, and grounded home corners for Neuma massagers.
A structured multi-shot production system (World, Inhabited Hero, Icon silhouette, and verified Detail/Intelligence crops) paired with separated graphic panels for performance or sale messaging.
avoid: Treating draft Visual World Guide rules, the 8-item/100-point scorecard, 'Locked Characters' slides, or Archive.zip rooms as approved mandatory brand specifications.
Flooding rooms with Duroflex red or adding red bedding, red curtains, red props, and red clothing.
Clinical/medical fear-mongering, anatomical pain glows, hospital aesthetics, luxury spa clichés, ornate hotel/palace staging, or floating black-box electronics voids.
Performative ad behaviour: camera stares, thumbs-up gestures, stiff showroom sitting, exaggerated smiles, loud prints, or shiny synthetic clothing.

Presenting strategic RTBs (e.g., 200K strands, 4X airflow, cortisol reduction) or unverified website claims (e.g., 1 lakh+ fibres, 3X breathability, flat 50% vs 4–20% discount conflicts) as validated facts without SKU-specific approval.
Renaming existing product ranges to proposed architecture names (Restore, Recharge, Oasis, Recalibrate) before official migration confirmation.
unknowns: Authoritative production vector masters, exact colour hex/Pantone specifications, and approved brand font files (official site uses solid red symbol + uppercase DUROFLEX, whereas the draft guide renders a lowercase serif wordmark while requesting clean sans-serif hierarchy).

Resolution of the draft guide's internal contradiction on environmental red (slide V128 prohibits red outfits, bedding, and props, while positive draft examples depict red shorts, throws, and cushions).
Official adoption status and migration map for the proposed portfolio architecture (Restore, Recharge, Oasis, Recalibrate, and expanded Neuma concepts) versus current website navigation.
Selected SKU, variant specifications, physical dimensions, motion-clearance requirements, and substantiated product-specific claims or promotional offer terms for a live campaign.
Verified paid-media creative patterns and social feed performance (Meta Ads Library returned HTTP 403 and social links are login-limited).
guide.decisionSummary: Anchor Duroflex's visual and verbal brief in its supported strategic essence ('Motivating Reset') and public philosophy ('Designed to De-Stress'), translating restoration into navigable, warm contemporary Indian homes where people pause, recover, and re-engage with everyday life. Enforce strict source governance: protect immutable official SKU appearance and physical branding, forbid artificial in-photo fades or overlays, and treat the 151-slide Visual World Guide and interior archive as draft/advisory proposals while holding typography masters, exact colour values, portfolio renaming, and SKU-specific efficacy claims as explicit unknowns until verified.
